objective: Introduce a governed public POST boundary that accepts a minimal insurance quote/contact request, validates and normalizes only approved public fields, creates one canonical River CRM lead, and atomically preserves insurance profile, acquisition attribution, auditable consent, and quote-request lifecycle evidence without exposing private River OS write controls or collecting sensitive underwriting/payment data.

architecture.privateRiverOsBoundary: The public route does not call, redirect through, or expose /river-os/actions/*.
architecture.domainBoundary: Request validation and orchestration live in src/lib/insurance. Generic CRM identity, acquisition, consent, event, and D1 contracts remain reusable River infrastructure.
architecture.atomicity: Creation of the canonical relationship and all INS-001C child records must execute as one D1 batch/unit. A request must not report success when only part of the CRM growth record set was written.
architecture.deduplicationPolicy: INS-001C creates one new canonical relationship per accepted submission. Cross-submission person deduplication or lead association is deferred until a separately specified identity/deduplication rule exists.
architecture.productionPolicy: Implementation and tests may use mocks and ephemeral/local D1 only. No production D1 migration, deployment, or live request is authorized by this slice.

publicRequestContract.contactRule: At least one of phone or email is required. Supplying both is allowed.

normalizationRules: firstName and lastName are trimmed non-empty text and are combined into canonical CRM displayName.
Email is trimmed and normalized to lowercase when provided.
Phone is trimmed and must contain a usable telephone value when provided; INS-001C does not infer consent merely from presence of a phone number.
state and postalCode pass through the canonical InsuranceLeadProfile validation rules.
productInterest must use the canonical INS-001A insurance product values.
Public input cannot choose relationship kind, pipeline stage, CRM owner, assigned producer, quote status, timestamps, identifiers, or event types.
Blank optional attribution fields are omitted rather than stored as meaningful values.
Acquisition source for this public route is canonicalized to website; client input may provide attribution detail but may not replace the route's canonical source.

rules: Consent must be an object with explicit boolean channel choices rather than one ambiguous truthy value.
At least one provided contact channel must have explicit granted consent for the request to be accepted.
SMS consent cannot be granted without a phone number.
Phone consent cannot be granted without a phone number.
Email consent cannot be granted without an email address.
A consent record is persisted for each supplied contact channel with an explicit granted or denied state.
Consent capture source is website.
Consent capturedAt, createdAt, and updatedAt use the server-controlled accepted-request timestamp.
Public callers cannot submit revokedAt or doNotContact administrative state.

generatedIdentifiers.consentId: Server-generated consent:<uuid> for each persisted channel consent.
generatedIdentifiers.rule: Identifiers are generated server-side only and are never accepted from the public request body.

values: one server-generated consentId per supplied phone/sms/email channel
status = granted or denied from explicit public choice

rules: The operation receives already-canonical domain records, not arbitrary request JSON.
The operation creates prepared D1 statements for relationship, acquisition attribution, insurance profile, all channel consent records, lead-created event, and quote-requested event.
The operation executes those statements with D1 batch semantics.
Any failed batch member rejects the entire quote-request operation.
Foreign keys remain enabled by the schema/database environment.
No table outside the existing River CRM 0001/0002 schema is required.
POST only.
Require JSON content type.
Reject request bodies above the configured maximum before domain orchestration.
Parse JSON once.
Reject arrays, null, primitives, malformed JSON, unknown sensitive fields, and forbidden administrative fields.
Validate the request completely before invoking persistence.
Use server-generated identifiers and timestamp dependencies for deterministic tests.
The public route does not require River OS authentication.
Browser submissions must be same-origin when an Origin header is present.
Absence of an Origin header is not treated as authenticated identity; server-to-server requests remain subject to the same body validation.
Never return raw D1 errors or stack traces.

201.meaning: Quote request accepted and atomically persisted.

400.meaning: Malformed JSON or invalid public input.

403.meaning: Browser Origin header is present and does not match the request URL origin.

413.meaning: Request body exceeds public ingress limit.

testRequirements: Accept a valid phone-only quote request with explicit phone consent.
Accept a valid email-only quote request with explicit email consent.
Accept a request containing both phone and email.
Normalize names and email.
Reuse canonical state, postal-code, product-interest, acquisition, consent, event, and insurance-profile validators.
Reject a request with neither phone nor email.
Reject phone or SMS consent when phone is absent.
Reject email consent when email is absent.
Reject a request with no granted contact channel.
Reject malformed JSON.
Reject non-object JSON.
Reject forbidden administrative fields.
Reject explicitly forbidden sensitive fields.
Reject unsupported product interests.
Reject invalid state or postal code.
Reject oversized bodies.
Reject unsupported content type.
Reject cross-origin browser writes.
Generate identifiers server-side.
Use one server timestamp consistently across records created from one request.
Create a canonical lead at stage new with source website.
Create insurance profile with quoteStatus requested.
Persist structured acquisition attribution.
Persist explicit per-channel consent evidence.
Emit lead-created and quote-requested events.
Execute all records as one D1 batch.
Propagate batch failure without returning success.
Return 201 only after successful persistence.
Route wiring uses RIVER_CRM_DB and does not reference private River OS action routes.
No Sesh route, source, persistence, or schema file changes.
acceptanceCriteria: Public request input is narrower than private CRM administration input.
Canonical River CRM relationship identity remains the parent record.
A successful request produces relationship, acquisition, insurance profile, consent, and event records.
All records for one accepted request are persisted through one D1 batch/unit.
Public callers cannot select CRM administrative state or identifiers.
No sensitive underwriting/payment fields are accepted or stored.
Private River OS write routes are not exposed or reused as public ingress.
Focused domain, D1, HTTP, and route-wiring tests pass.
Repository-wide existing type debt is not broadened into INS-001C.
No production D1 resource or deployment is touched.
Working-tree scope remains limited to the INS-001C specification and its planned files.
